sahneler.metin: Fire tore through a chicken processing plant in Hamlet, North Carolina.
Within minutes, twenty five workers were killed.
Maintenance had patched a hydraulic line with improvised parts.
It separated and sprayed fluid near a fryer.
Several exits had been locked, including a fire exit.
The plant had never had a safety inspection.
